truths.truth: `weight.mjs resident` composes per-command eager/reachable bytes and per-role dispatch bytes, and the numbers equal a hand `wc -c` sum over the same file lists the envelope names
truths.evidence: `node cadence-core/bin/weight.mjs resident --command cad-land` -> eagerBytes 17934 / reachableBytes 59304; hand sum: SKILL.md 11488 + git-guard.md 6446 = 17934 exact, and 11488+6446+4611(git-publish)+15134(review-triggers)+18575(seams)+3050(triage-gate) = 59304 exact. `--role cad-executor` -> agents/cad-executor.md 424 + skills/cad-executor-contract/SKILL.md 12625 = 13049, xhigh 411+12625 = 13036, both exact against `wc -c`. cadence-core/bin/lib/resident-weight.mjs + lib/frontmatter.mjs exist and are wired through cadence-core/bin/weight.mjs; `node --test cadence-core/bin/weight.test.mjs` = 20/20 pass. Noted, not a criterion failure: `--command` filters only the commands array (all 19 role rows still print) and `--role` filters only roles (all 23 command rows still print); the test at weight.test.mjs:217 pins that filters narrow only their own array.

truths.truth: `weight.mjs` has a CONTRACTS entry, self-verify returns ok:true, AND removing the entry makes self-verify report it rather than passing
truths.evidence: Entry present at cadence-core/bin/self-verify.mjs:178-181 (`'weight.mjs': { '*': ['--root'], resident: ['--command','--role'] }`), INTERNALS.md:79 invokes `weight.mjs resident --root <repo root>`, live self-verify = ok:true over 18 checks, 0 problems. Negative half refuted on a disposable `git archive HEAD` copy: deleting the whole `'weight.mjs'` block still returns ok:true with zero problems, because check 2 does `const contract = CONTRACTS[script]; if (!contract) continue;` at self-verify.mjs:469-470 - an unlisted script is silently skipped. Positive control on the same copy (entry restored, INTERNALS.md flag changed to `--bogus`) does fire `unknown-flag`, so the entry has teeth for flags only, never for its own absence.

truths.truth: `cad-land`'s eager bytes are strictly below the mean of cad-execute/cad-plan/cad-verify, with before and after both committed
truths.evidence: After: cad-land eager 17934 (live run, hand-summed above). Mean: (25017 cad-execute + 16438 cad-plan + 20136 cad-verify)/3 = 61591/3 = 20530.333, each term hand-checked (execute.md 24275 + SKILL 742; plan.md 15590 + 848; verify.md 13758 + UAT.md 5276 + 1102). 17934 < 20530.33. Before: reproduced by running `weight.mjs resident` from a `git archive 01d220a` copy - cad-land eager 32676 (11096 + 6446 + 15134 at that sha, confirmed by `git show 01d220a:skills/cad-land/SKILL.md | wc -c` = 11096). Both figures committed in .planning/phases/2/MEASUREMENTS.md:44 and :131.

truths.truth: `cad-plan-review`'s eager bytes drop by at least the 15,134 B review-triggers.md include

Before at 01d220a: 2377 (`git show`) + 15134 = 17511, matching MEASUREMENTS.md:48. Drop = 15158 >= 15134. `wc -c cadence-core/references/review-triggers.md` = 15134 exactly, so the criterion's constant is the real file size.

truths.truth: seams.md's deferral rule states a size term, names `weight.mjs resident` as the decider, names references/git-guard.md as the multi-step case that stays eager, and scopes the inline bytes-and-count requirement forward from that sentence
truths.evidence: cadence-core/references/seams.md:229-243: 'That test omits a SIZE term, and this is it: an eager @-include costs its bytes times every remaining turn ... `weight.mjs resident` is what decides which side a given include falls on', then 'references/git-guard.md stays eager at steps 1, 2 and 3', then 'Any deferral made from this point forward states, inline at the Read itself, the reference's measured bytes and its consult-site count ... the deferrals already in cad-land predate this sentence and are not held to it'. The two in-tree deferrals do carry the figure inline (skills/cad-land/SKILL.md:44, skills/cad-plan-review/SKILL.md:39).

truths.truth: Check 13 protects the Read at the STEP/ARM that needs the reference, as AC5 words it and as lib/deferred-reads.mjs:24-33 claims
truths.evidence: Reproduced on a disposable copy: deleting the step-4b instruction at skills/cad-land/SKILL.md:109-111 ('**Read the publish rails first.** Read `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.../git-publish.md` before the first bullet below that publishes anything') and adding one equivalent decoy sentence inside `<objective>` leaves check 13 silent (self-verify's only remaining problem is an unrelated `budget-overrun` from my byte-size edit). deferred-reads.mjs:145-146 counts qualifying sentences FILE-WIDE (`sentences(text).filter(...)`), with no notion of which step or arm the sentence sits under, while the module header at :23-29 asserts the sentence unit is 'protecting each arm's own sentence'. Confirms the SUMMARY's MEDIUM open item.

truths.truth: `weight.mjs` fails loudly rather than silently measuring the wrong tree when `--root` carries no value
truths.evidence: `node cadence-core/bin/weight.mjs resident --command cad-land --root` (no value) returns ok:true with the Cadence repo's own numbers (eagerBytes 17934), because weight.mjs:39 does `flagValue(argv,'--root') || join(HERE,'..','..')`. A real but nonexistent root fails correctly (`--root /nonexistent-xyz` -> ok:false unknown-command), so only the valueless/empty case is silent. Confirms the SUMMARY's MEDIUM open item; it does not move any figure recorded in MEASUREMENTS.md, which was produced without `--root`.

gaps.name: weight.mjs is contracted in self-verify (AC2)
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - the criterion's second clause does not hold: deleting the CONTRACTS entry does NOT make self-verify report it. self-verify.mjs:469-470 skips any script absent from CONTRACTS (`if (!contract) continue`), so removing the entry returns ok:true with zero problems.
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/self-verify.mjs:178-181 holds the entry and INTERNALS.md:79 invokes `weight.mjs resident --root <repo root>`, so the passing half is real. On a `git archive HEAD` copy: entry deleted -> ok:true, problems []. Same copy with the entry restored and INTERNALS.md's flag changed to `--bogus` -> ok:false `unknown-flag weight.mjs resident --bogus`, proving the check is live and the silence is the missing-entry path. Also confirmed on that copy: rewriting INTERNALS.md:79 to the script's PRIMARY form `weight.mjs --root <repo root>` turns self-verify red with `unknown-subcommand weight.mjs --root`, because the entry enumerates only `resident` - the SUMMARY's LOW finding, reproduced.
gaps.missing: A check that every script under cadence-core/bin (or a stated allowlist) has a CONTRACTS row, so dropping a row is itself a problem instead of a silent opt-out of check 2; plus a no-subcommand form in the weight.mjs entry so `weight.mjs --root <path>` is contracted rather than reported as unknown-subcommand.

gaps.name: Check 13 counts Read sentences file-wide, so a step's own Read can be deleted while the check stays green
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - AC5 requires the Read to be present 'at the step that needs' the reference, and lib/deferred-reads.mjs:24-33 claims the sentence unit protects 'each arm's own sentence', but the counting at :145-146 is over the whole file with no step or arm scoping.
gaps.evidence: Reproduced on a disposable copy of HEAD: removed the step-4b publish-rails Read at skills/cad-land/SKILL.md:109-111 and inserted one equivalent sentence inside `<objective>`; check 13 reported nothing (the run's only problem was an unrelated budget-overrun caused by my edit's byte delta). The `git.auto_close` arm then reaches its publish bullets with references/git-publish.md never Read.
gaps.missing: Scope the sentence count to the region that owns the deferral - a per-row anchor (step heading, list item, or a named block) so each registered read paragraph is counted only inside the arm it protects, and update the module header to match whatever rule ships.

gaps.name: weight.mjs falls back to its own tree on a valueless --root
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - a caller passing an unset variable gets the Cadence repo's numbers with ok:true instead of an error.
gaps.evidence: `node cadence-core/bin/weight.mjs resident --command cad-land --root` returns ok:true / eagerBytes 17934 (this repo's own figure). weight.mjs:39 `flagValue(argv,'--root') || join(HERE,'..','..')`. A nonexistent-but-present value fails correctly (`--root /nonexistent-xyz` -> ok:false unknown-command), so only the empty case is silent. No figure in MEASUREMENTS.md is affected: those runs pass no --root.
gaps.missing: Distinguish 'flag absent' from 'flag present with no value' in flagValue/weight.mjs and return ok:false with an `internal`-class reason for the latter, as the pre-292b599 behaviour did.

gaps.name: MEASUREMENTS.md cites evidence that does not reproduce (`orphans` null)
gaps.reason: behavior wrong (documentation) - the recorded audit evidence names a key the envelope never emits.
gaps.evidence: .planning/phases/2/MEASUREMENTS.md:252-255 records `orphans` null from `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs audit`; the live envelope has no `orphans` key at all (planning.mjs spreads it only when non-empty). Every other claim in that bullet reproduces: ok:true, CTX-01 at phase 2 with plan phases/2/PLAN.md and break not-verified, no unpicked for CTX-01.
gaps.missing: Restate the evidence as 'no `orphans` key in the envelope' (absence, not null), or leave it and accept the drift.
